research_rationale:
Executive Order 11990 of May 24, 1977 (42 FR 26961; held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11990.txt, read in full) is the wetlands protection order: section 1 directs each agency to minimize destruction of wetlands in land management, construction and land-use activities (excluding permits to private parties on non-Federal property); section 2 requires findings before new construction in wetlands and early public review; section 3 requires budget requests to state accord with the order; section 4 governs disposal of Federally owned wetlands; section 5 lists factors; section 6 requires agency procedures; section 7 defines terms; section 8 states transitional exclusions and an October 1, 1977 implementation date; section 9 excludes emergency work; section 10 allows applicants to assume responsibilities. The only amendment found is Executive Order 12608 section 28 (September 9, 1987), which struck 'and the Water Resources Council' from section 6. The U.S. Code note prints the order as amended and a July 10, 2026 Federal Register proposed rule of the Department of Housing and Urban Development cites it as in force. The order is operative on 2026-10-14.
